title: The Washday of Saturn’s Rings
description: On Ring Washday, the rooftop washer hangs Saturn’s rings out to dry. She’ll put them back before breakfast.
alt: A silver-haired washer in a mustard apron clips a shimmering strip to a rooftop clothesline beneath a rose-colored Saturn.
pairing: An imagined winter washday × hanging Saturn’s rings on a clothesline
